title: Atlas Reweave: durable computation with versioned acceptance
description: A local Python execution library separating immutable computation from versioned acceptance, with dependency revalidation, bounded streaming, durable producer-attempt accounting and an optional MCP interface. This deposit preserves a dated source snapshot of an experimental implementation. Deterministic examples and benchmarks do not establish model learning or independent scientific validation.
